test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 3rd December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Three years ago, the value of a flat was Rs. 65,00,000. Its value depreciated at the rate of 5%, 4% and 3% at the end of the first, the second and the third year, respectively. What is its present value?
solution:
Given:

Three years ago, the value of a flat was Rs. 65,00,000. Its value depreciated at the rate of 5%, 4% and 3% at the end of the first, the second and the third year, respectively. 

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

where

P = Principal amount & R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years

One year of Simple interest = One year of Compound Interest

Calculation:

Depreciated by for the first year = (6500000 × 5 × 1)/100

⇒ Rs. 325000

New value becomes = 6500000 - 325000 = Rs. 6175000

Depreciated by for the second year = (6175000 × 4 × 1)/100

⇒ Rs. 247000

New value becomes = 6175000 - 247000 = Rs. 5928000

Depreciated by for the third year = (5928000 × 3 × 1)/100

⇒ Rs. 177840

Present value of the flat = 5928000 - 177840 = Rs. 57,50,160

**∴ The present value of the flat is Rs. 57,50,160.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** According to the question, 

⇒ 65,00,000 × 95/100 × 96/100 × 97/100

⇒ 57,50,160

∴ The present value of the flat is Rs. 57,50,160.
